en: A one-hundred-twenty-five-billion-parameter model, on one gaming GPU?
zh: 一张游戏显卡，跑一千二百五十亿参数的大模型？

en: The trick: most of its experts live in system memory.
zh: 秘诀是：大部分专家，其实放在内存里。

en: Each token uses only a few, copied over just in time.
zh: 每个词只用到其中几个，用到再搬上显卡。

en: But copying is slow. One Qwen3 expert is about nineteen megabytes, and PCIe moves about twenty-five gigabytes a second.
zh: 可搬运很慢：Qwen3 一个专家大约十九兆，PCIe 每秒只能搬二十五 G 左右。

en: If those picks were random, a GPU holding a quarter of them would miss three times out of four.
zh: 如果专家是随机选的，显卡放下四分之一，四次里有三次要现搬。

en: That's over ten gigabytes per token. About two tokens a second.
zh: 每个词要搬十 G 以上，一秒只能出两个词左右。

en: They're not. On our released traces of Qwen3, the same space hits seventy-seven percent.
zh: 但它们不是随机的。在我们公开的 Qwen3 数据上，同样的空间，命中率百分之七十七。

en: Plain LRU caching already gets seventy-five. Predicting from recent use does a little better.
zh: 普通的 LRU 缓存就有百分之七十五，按最近的使用来预测，还能再高一点。

en: Give the GPU half the experts, and prediction cuts the copying by a third: from about seventeen to twenty-five tokens a second, at the PCIe limit.
zh: 显卡放下一半专家时，预测能把搬运量砍掉三分之一：按 PCIe 算，上限从每秒十七个词左右，提到二十五个。

en: Patterns behind chaos. Our ISCA twenty-six best paper.
zh: 混乱背后有规律。我们的 ISCA 2026 最佳论文。

en: The traces are open. Links below.
zh: 数据全部公开，链接在评论区。
